method.2021: Tom10, Labour force. Table10 all employed15+ and same NP; table12 employed outsideNP and frequency; join by exact published geography label and urban/rural category. Same-subject otherNP = sameSubject - sameNP. Outside includes reported outsideNP even when work subject not given. unresolvedNP = all - sameNP - reportedOutsideNP. OutsideNP-with-unknown-subject = outsideNP - (sameSubjectOtherNP + otherSubject + abroad); it is not all unknown-territory workers.
method.2010: Buryatia Tom7, Economically active and inactive population, table9, age15–72. Known outsideNP = all - sameNP - unknownWorkplace. This does NOT mean outside the municipality. K/К suppression is null, not zero. Exact outside computed only when all three inputs numeric; unresolved headings are NOT guessed.
method.geographic_grain: 2021: federal subjects + 8 FD + 2 oblast remainder aggregates; urban/rural. 2010: nested municipality, municipality-settlement and urbanNP; rural municipality-settlement NOT equated with named ruralNP.
method.denominators: Employed residents in private households; NOT entire population, NOT registered jobs, NOT all outgoing workers. Census2021 15+ vs2010 15–72, not silently comparable.
method.overlap: Do not sum95 geography labels: FD, Archangelsk includingNAO and NAO, Tyumen includingKhMAO/YaNAO and autonomous districts, and remainder versions overlap. aggregate_overlap flags inclusive oblasts, nestedsubjects and FD.2010 administrative levels also overlap.
method.limits: NOT origin-destination matrices. No destination city identified. OutsideNP share does not estimate travel distance or identify the decay exponent by itself; it can constrain modeled outside fractions when denominators, geography and travel frequency match.2010 is temporally separate validation. Remote/rare monthly journeys are not daily commuting. Unknowns remain an uncertainty interval. No empirical settlement-level2021 workplace share invented.

population_join.method: exact unique normalized name within Buryatia; ONLY explicit urbanNP or exacturbanokrug=NP headings;11unique matches; all employed2010 <= population2010. Historical2010 MO boundaries not crosswalked to2021 NP.
